snippet.title: Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Open your mind and let your story unfold.

Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars is an RPG presented entirely through the medium of cards.

Check out this fascinating world of swords and sorcery, brought to you from the creative talents of YOKO TARO (Creative Director), Keiichi Okabe (Music Director) and Kimihiko Fujisaka (Character Designer)!

Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars is available now on:
Nintendo Switch™: http://sqex.link/9jw0
PlayStation®4: http://sqex.link/7hsi
Steam®: http://sqex.link/16019f
